- tune eviction threshold (owner: toshi) due 24h
- canary rollback + validation (owner: sam) due 36h
- customer note draft (owner: comms) due EOD tomorrow
- follow-up architecture PR (owner: eng-runtime) due sprint 28

toshi: snippet added to RCA for oncall:
``
# quick deploy tune
kubectl -n redwood set env deploy/policy-router EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.85
# validate cache health
curl -s http://local-metrics/policy/cache | jq .evictions
```
